title: ARC Raiders x Subway: Exclusive Subterranean outfit
body:
# ARC Raiders x Subway: Exclusive Subterranean outfit

## Never Raid Hungry

Has this ever happened to you? You load into a map with your best gear on. You've packed plenty of ammo. Right as you're about to check the map, you hear it: a deep, sinister growl. Your body starts shaking. Is that a Matriarch on patrol nearby? Did Lance sell you expired stims again?

Actually, no. You broke the Raider's golden rule: "Never go Topside on an empty stomach!"

ARC Raiders has partnered with Subway for a limited-time opportunity to unlock exclusive in-game rewards.

## How to participate

Between Aug 20 and Oct 26, raiders can unlock in-game rewards by buying any qualifying Subway® meal*. This offer only applies at participating US Subway locations, through the Subway app, or via Subway.com.

Each participant gets a unique single-use code that unlocks the exclusive Subterranean outfit, one of three possible Subway-themed outfit variants, along with two bonus in-game items that rotate on a weekly basis for the duration of the promotion. These codes work on PlayStation, Xbox, or PC.

For complete details, each week's newly added rewards bundle, and code redemption, check the official program site at arcraiders.com/subway or the Subway app.

Applies at participating U.S. restaurants only. Requires offer opt-in. Customers receive one (1) ARC Raiders Code (the "Code(s)") per qualifying Subway® meal purchase (Kids Meals excluded). Limit of one (1) Code per order. Valid from 8/20/26 through 10/26/26, or while supplies last. Codes can be redeemed at until 11/10/26. Must be age 13 or older. Full Terms are available at Subway.com/en-us/arcraiders.
